## PT-1313 — THE ORIGIN AND LOCALITY SYSTEM. ⚠ THE PLANET DECLARES ITS OWN GRAPH, THE GALAXY LAYERS ARE UNIFORM, and a character carries TWO RINGS

Owner designed the locality hierarchy the character brain needed. PT-1312 recorded it as the one genuinely missing piece; this is it.

⚠⚠ TWO RINGS, NOT ONE, AND A CHARACTER GETS THE BETTER OF THEM. Owner described TWO KINDS OF LOCAL and they are genuinely different axes. WHERE THEY ARE  the zone they stand in, so an offworlder in the Upper City still hears Upper City gossip. WHERE THEY ARE FROM  their home, so a Taris native in the Upper City knows Undercity things an offworlder in the same spot does not.

AND THAT IS WHAT MAKES A WELL-TRAVELLED NPC INTERESTING: a merchant standing on Taris who is FROM Corellia CARRIES A TARIS RING AND A CORELLIA RING, and knows odd things nobody around them knows. A single current-location ring could not produce that.

⚠⚠ THE STRUCTURAL RULING, AND IT IS THE ONE THAT MAKES THIS BUILDABLE: THE PLANET DECLARES ITS OWN LOCALITY GRAPH; THE GALAXY LAYERS ARE UNIFORM.

    PER PLANET, AUTHORED        UNIFORM EVERYWHERE
      zone                        region
      neighbour                   galaxy
      planet
      and more if the planet needs them

Owners reasoning, adopted: WHAT COUNTS AS A ZONE AND A NEIGHBOUR FOR ONE PLANET IS NOT THE SAME AS FOR ANOTHER, AND SOME MIGHT HAVE EXTRA TIERS. Taris declares Upper, Lower and Undercity. Tatooine declares spaceport, next settlement, deep desert. A PLANET WITH FIVE MEANINGFUL LAYERS DECLARES FIVE. But region and galaxy are generalised, because THERE ARE A LOT OF FACTS ABOUT THE GALAXY AND MORE SPECIFIC FACTS ABOUT THE WAY PLANETS ARE SET UP.

AND THE ATLAS ALREADY CARRIES region AND parent AS REGISTER FIELDS, so THE TOP OF THE HIERARCHY HAS DATA BEHIND IT and only the bottom is new authoring.

⚠ FALLOFF IS A PROPERTY OF THE GRAPH, NOT A FIXED TABLE. Distance is not tier 2 of 5  IT IS HOW MANY HOPS FROM WHERE YOU ARE TO WHERE THE FACT IS. One hop is one hop whether the planet has three layers or six.

⚠⚠ AND THE FAILURE THAT RULING WOULD OTHERWISE CREATE, CAUGHT BEFORE IT WAS BUILT: A DEEPER PLANET WOULD PUNISH ITS OWN RESIDENTS. If Taris has three layers and another world has six, A SIX-LAYER LOCAL ASKING ABOUT THE FAR SIDE OF THEIR OWN PLANET IS FIVE HOPS OUT  FURTHER THAN A TARIS LOCAL ASKING ABOUT ANOTHER PLANET ENTIRELY. Clearly wrong.

RULED, owner agreeing the recommendation: HOPS WITHIN A PLANET ARE CHEAPER THAN THE JUMP OFF IT. Crossing to another world is A BIGGER STEP than crossing your own, REGARDLESS OF HOW SUBDIVIDED YOUR WORLD IS. ⚠ THAT PRESERVES THE IDEA THAT A WELL-SUBDIVIDED PLANET IS A DETAILED PLACE RATHER THAN A LARGE ONE  Tariss Undercity is SOCIALLY far from the Upper City and still obviously Taris, and everyone there knows it exists.

The rejected alternative was CAPPING the planet ring so anything on your own world sits at most at planet distance. It works and is blunter; the hop-cost version produces the same protection while KEEPING DISTANCE MEANINGFUL WITHIN A WORLD.

⚠ ONE ITEM RAISED AND NOT YET RULED: whether the neighbour probability is FLAT or VARIES BY WHAT IS ASKED. Owner offered 50% for a neighbouring zone. Proposed refinement, unresolved: THE TIER SETS A BASE AND THE FACTS TIER MODIFIES IT, so FLAVOUR TRAVELS FURTHER THAN PLOT  otherwise a guard is EQUALLY LIKELY TO KNOW A JOKE AND A SECRET FROM THE NEXT DISTRICT.

    DOES THIS NPC KNOW ABOUT THIS?     seeded  3.2s roll from who x what

So conversation options GROW BECAUSE A FACT ENTERED THE LEDGER, NOT BECAUSE AN AI DECIDED THEY SHOULD.

SO THE FULL PICTURE, ASSEMBLED FROM THREE DOCUMENTS THAT EACH HELD A PIECE:

    THE TOPIC SPACE      what CAN be asked  closed taxonomy, opened by the binder
    THE SEED             does THIS NPC know about THIS topic  who x what
    THE LOCALITY RINGS   PT-1313  how far the topic is from them, feeding the seed
    DECLARED FACTS       exact content that MUST be exact, flag-gated

⚠ AND THE RULING THAT FOLLOWS: AN AUTHOR DECLARES A FACT WHEN THE WORDING MATTERS OR THE DISCLOSURE MATTERS. Everything else is A TOPIC THEY MAY OR MAY NOT KNOW ABOUT, and the AI says it in character within the locality and tier constraints. THE AUTHOR NEVER WRITES FLAVOUR AND NEVER TAGS IT  which is exactly the scale answer PT-1305 proposed, now grounded in a test rather than an assertion.

⚠ ONE CONSEQUENCE WORTH STATING BECAUSE IT CONSTRAINS THE BUILDER: A DECLARED FACT IS AN AUTHORING COST AND A SEEDED TOPIC IS FREE, SO THE DEFAULT MUST BE SEEDED OR AUTHORS WILL DECLARE EVERYTHING. But IF IN DOUBT FLAG IT PUSHES THE OTHER WAY. Those are not in conflict  THE DOUBT RULE APPLIES ONLY WHEN A FACT COULD PLAUSIBLY CHANGE THE TRAJECTORY. A rumour about ship traffic never could, so it never reaches the doubt test at all.

## PT-1315 — DEFLECTION ON SCREEN. ⚠ THE REFUSAL IS NEVER LABELLED AS ONE, and a PRICE survives on an option where a DC does not

Item 4 of the character brain, taken next because the dialogue surface was still warm. Owner approved the shape.

⚠ RULES-02s OWN CORRECTION IS WHAT DEFINES THE REQUIREMENT, and it is worth quoting because it names the failure precisely: the original draft HARDCODED A VERBATIM DEFLECTION LINE, and REPEATED PROBING PRODUCED AN IDENTICAL SENTENCE THREE TIMES AND KILLED THE CHARACTER. So the screen design has one job: THREE REFUSALS MUST BE THREE SENTENCES.

⚠⚠ THE REFUSAL IS NEVER LABELLED AS ONE. No he wont tell you banner, no greyed marker, no state indicator. THE NPC JUST TALKS AND THE PLAYER WORKS OUT THEY ARE BEING STONEWALLED  WHICH IS WHAT STONEWALLING IS. Signalling it would break the fiction THE STANCES EXIST TO PROTECT, and it would also leak that a fact is there to be had, which is itself information.

ESCALATION IS VISIBLE IN TONE, NOT IN A METER. Grath answers to whoever is paying, then ask the clerks up at the guild hall, then AND IVE TOLD YOU TWICE  SAME STANCE THROUGHOUT, deflect_to_authority, WITH THE ESCALATION FIELD SHIFTING THE REGISTER. The stance says WHERE he sends you; escalation says HOW TIRED HE IS OF SENDING YOU THERE.

⚠ AND THE GATE OPTIONS STAY ON SCREEN THROUGHOUT, which is the choice that makes the whole thing readable: [Persuade] and [Bribe] visible WHILE HE IS REFUSING, so THE REFUSAL READS AS A DOOR WITH A PRICE RATHER THAN A WALL. That is RULES-02 3s any_of made legible  the player can see the routes without being told a route exists.

⚠⚠ AND ONE GENUINE EXCEPTION TO PT-1307, WHICH REMOVED ALL NUMBERS FROM OPTIONS: A PRICE SURVIVES WHERE A DC DOES NOT. [Bribe 50 credits] carries its number and [Persuade] does not.

THE REASONING, AND IT IS NOT INCONSISTENCY: PT-1307 REMOVED DCs BECAUSE A ROLL YOU CANNOT INFLUENCE DOES NOT BENEFIT FROM ARITHMETIC  you pick, you roll, you find out. A PRICE IS DIFFERENT BECAUSE YOU CAN CHOOSE TO PAY IT. A player deciding whether fifty credits is worth this answer NEEDS TO KNOW IT IS FIFTY. A player deciding whether to attempt a Persuade cannot act on the DC at all.

SO THE RULE GENERALISES CLEANLY: A NUMBER APPEARS ON AN OPTION WHEN THE PLAYER CAN ACT ON IT, AND NOT OTHERWISE. That covers both rulings without either being an exception to the other.

## TRACE-95 — Repeated asking. ⚠ KOTORS FORMAT HAS NO CONCEPT OF A SECOND VISIT, and DAGGERFALL HAS THREE REAL MECHANISMS  one of which is our seeded gate, shipped in 1996

⚠ THE NEGATIVE IS CLEAN AND COMPLETE. Every field name at every level of the DLG format in both games, searched for visit, once, seen, shown, repeat, count, used, been, prior, already, first and time. K1 has 78 distinct field names and K2 has 159. NONE MATCH, IN EITHER GAME.

⚠ AND IT IS NOT AN OVERSIGHT ONE GAME FIXED. K2 MORE THAN DOUBLED THE FIELD COUNT  eighteen gate fields, a second action script, twelve parameter slots, Emotion, FacialAnim, a whole VO pipeline  AND ADDED NOTHING HERE. THE FORMAT HAS NO CONCEPT OF A SECOND VISIT.

DIRECT LOOP-BACKS ARE RARE  375 of 48,659 transitions in K1, 0.8%  AND THAT IS THE WRONG MEASURE. RE-ENTRANCY IS THE REAL SHAPE: 17.0% of K1 speaker nodes and 14.6% of K2s are REACHABLE FROM MORE THAN ONE PLACE, and ⚠ THE CONCENTRATION IS EXACTLY WHERE PLAYERS SPEND THEIR TIME  k_hjuh_dialog 131, k_hcar_dialog 104 in K1; handmaiden 123, kreia 111, t3m4 108 in K2. THE COMPANION CONVERSATIONS. So ASKING TWICE IS THE NORMAL MODE AND THE FORMAT TRACKS NONE OF IT.

⚠ WRITERS BUILT WORKAROUNDS AND K2 NEEDED TWICE AS MANY  25 of 1,185 globals in K1, 45 of 999 in K2. K1s shape is KNOWLEDGE, with eleven Korriban KNOW_ flags. K2s shape is SEQUENCE, and the clearest case is DAMNING: 101PER_Atton_Intro_1, _2, _3, _4  FOUR GLOBAL BOOLEANS STANDING IN FOR A COUNTER, because there is no counter, EACH BURNING A ROW IN A GAME-WIDE PREDECLARATION TABLE WITH A 999-ROW BUDGET.

⚠⚠ DAGGERFALL HAS THREE REAL MECHANISMS AND ALL THREE MATTER TO US.

numQuestionsAsked IS A PER-CONVERSATION COUNTER  zero asked gives greeting phrasing, otherwise follow-up phrasing. ⚠ AND THE PLAYERS OWN QUESTION IS WORDED DIFFERENTLY THE SECOND TIME, which is a thing neither KOTOR nor our design had considered.

maxNumAnswersNpcGivesTellMeAboutOrRumors = 1. AN ORDINARY NPC GIVES ONE ANSWER AND THEN DECLINES, unless physically in the same building as the topic. ASKING TWICE IS EXPLICITLY HANDLED BY REFUSING  which is the TEETH version of escalation, shipped.

⚠⚠ AND ASKING TWICE GIVES THE SAME ANSWER DELIBERATELY, seeded from hash of THIS NPC plus the topic key plus the building key. ONE NPC ALWAYS ANSWERS THE SAME WAY WHILE A DIFFERENT NPC ANSWERS DIFFERENTLY. VARIETY ACROSS THE POPULATION, CONSISTENCY PER PERSON  THE OPPOSITE OF RE-ROLLING. That is ENGINE-SPEC-03 3.2s SEEDED GATE, SHIPPED IN 1996, and it confirms the mechanism rather than merely inspiring it.

TONE BY CONTEXT: KOTOR does it at 10.0% of K1 replies and 6.9% of K2s, with an extreme case in K2s 000react where ONE REPLY CARRIES FIFTY-ONE GATED TARGETS. ⚠ BUT THE GATE VOCABULARY LIMITS WHAT CAN VARY  conditions are dominated by flags and quest stages, so DELIVERY VARIES BY WHAT HAS HAPPENED AND ESSENTIALLY NEVER BY WHO THE LISTENER IS. c_ismale at 240 uses is close to the only identity gate in the game.

DAGGERFALL COMPUTES REACTION FROM FIVE INPUTS: faction reputation, BiographyReactionMod, social-group modifier, SGroupReputations, Personality over five, and a session-cached tone.

⚠⚠ AND BiographyReactionMod IS THE CHARACTER-CREATION QUESTIONNAIRE  THE TWELVE MULTIPLE-CHOICE QUESTIONS FROM TRACE-89s FREE-TEXT STUDY  REACHING INTO HOW STRANGERS TALK TO YOU YEARS OF PLAY LATER. The agent calls it the single most impressive thing either game does on this axis and I agree. IT IS PT-1266s HANDLE PRINCIPLE PROVEN IN A SHIPPED GAME: A CREATION CHOICE CARRIES A STABLE ID AND LATER CONTENT REFERENCES IT.

THE BASELINE, PLAINLY: KOTOR HAS ONE AUTHORED STRING PER NODE  the text never changes, branching picks a different node, and Emotion and FacialAnim vary PERFORMANCE, NEVER WORDS. Daggerfall has ONE TEMPLATE PER SITUATION WITH THE SITUATION COMPUTED. NEITHER VARIES ON WOUNDED, TIME OF DAY OR ALIGNMENT.

## PT-1316 — THE ESCALATION TRACK. ⚠ DERIVED NOT STORED, TONE NOT DIFFICULTY, and it reaches the PLAYERS line too

Item 3 of the character brain, taken slowly at owners request as the riskiest remaining piece. Four risks were identified before designing, and TRACE-95 answered three of them from shipped precedent.

⚠ RISK ONE, AND IT WAS ARCHITECTURAL: ESCALATION LOOKS LIKE THE ACCUMULATION PT-1311 BANNED. An NPC getting more irritable each time you push IS accumulation, and a stored irritation counter would reintroduce the dynamic-memory problem that ruling exists to avoid.

RESOLVED: ESCALATION IS A COUNT OF ASKS ON THIS TOPIC IN THIS CONVERSATION. Nothing written, nothing persisted. ⚠ AND DAGGERFALL SHIPPED THIS EXACT ANSWER  numQuestionsAsked IS A PER-CONVERSATION COUNTER that changes greeting phrasing to follow-up phrasing AND NEVER PERSISTS. It also keeps ENGINE-SPEC-03 4.3 intact, which rules that off-script text WRITES NOTHING TO THE LEDGER  because if escalation were logged, free-typed asks would have to be logged too.

⚠⚠ RISK TWO, THE DEATH SPIRAL, AND THIS IS THE RULE MOST LIKELY TO BE SOFTENED LATER: IT CHANGES TONE, NEVER DIFFICULTY, NEVER THE GATE. If a failed Persuade raised irritation, and irritation lowered attitude, and attitude gates the fact, THE PLAYER IS PUNISHED TWICE FOR ONE FAILURE and each attempt makes the next harder. Players find that by getting stuck.

RISK THREE, LOCKOUT: PT-1315 made escalation INVISIBLE  tone, not a meter  and ⚠ INVISIBLE STATE THAT CAN LOCK YOU OUT IS THE WORST AVAILABLE COMBINATION. So it cannot close a gate and NO FACT IS EVER PERMANENTLY LOST TO IT.

AND THE TEETH, WHERE TEETH ARE WANTED: ESCALATION MAY END THE CONVERSATION. He walks off, you come back, NOTHING IS LOST. TRACE-95 found Daggerfall shipping precisely that  maxNumAnswersNpcGivesTellMeAboutOrRumors = 1, ONE ANSWER THEN A REFUSAL.

RISK FOUR, SCOPE: PER TOPIC so he is irritable about Grath rather than at you generally; PER CONVERSATION, matching numQuestionsAsked; PARTY-LEVEL, following 5s existing v1 ruling.

⚠ AND TRACE-95 ADDED SOMETHING NEITHER KOTOR NOR OUR DRAFT HAD CONSIDERED: ESCALATION REACHES THE PLAYERS OWN LINE. Daggerfall rewords THE PLAYERS QUESTION on a second ask. So a repeat is VISIBLE ON BOTH SIDES  who does Grath answer to becomes IM ASKING YOU. THE PLAYER SOUNDS LIKE SOMEONE ASKING TWICE, BECAUSE THEY ARE.

⚠⚠ AND OWNER RAISED THE GAP THAT WOULD HAVE KILLED IT: WITHOUT HANDLING FREE TEXT, ESCALATION IS DEAD FOR FREE-TEXT PLAYERS, because no two typed lines are byte-identical and the counter would only ever fire for people clicking options.

RESOLVED THROUGH MACHINERY ALREADY RULED RATHER THAN A NEW SIMILARITY JUDGEMENT: ENGINE-SPEC-03 3s topic space is A CLOSED TAXONOMY and PT-1303 already has the AI recognising a typed line as an authored option. Two differently-worded questions RESOLVE TO THE SAME TOPIC; same topic, second ask, counter increments. ⚠ THAT IS RECOGNITION AGAINST A FIXED SET RATHER THAN FREE-FORM SIMILARITY, which is exactly what PT-1303 requires to keep the AI DOING A MENU-READING JOB RATHER THAN MAKING A STORY DECISION  and it is testable under PT-1304s properties.

⚠ AND THE BASELINE WE ARE IMPROVING ON IS NOW MEASURED RATHER THAN ASSUMED. TRACE-95: KOTORS DLG FORMAT HAS NO CONCEPT OF A SECOND VISIT  no field in either game matches visit, once, seen, count or first  and K2 DOUBLED THE FIELD COUNT WITHOUT ADDING ONE. Its writers hand-built 101PER_Atton_Intro_1 THROUGH _4, FOUR GLOBAL BOOLEANS STANDING IN FOR A COUNTER. Owner predicted this and was right.

## PT-1317 — ⚠⚠ THE LAST TWO CHARACTER-BRAIN ITEMS CLOSED TOGETHER, because FOUR OF FIVE MAGIC VECTORS HAVE NO FORCE EQUIVALENT and THE DIVINATION PROBLEM DOES NOT PORT

Both remaining items were expected to need other work first  the matrix needing the Force power list extracted, and divination needing QUEST-MODEL-01 open beside it. ⚠ NEITHER TURNED OUT TO BE TRUE, AND CHECKING FIRST IS WHY. FORCE-POWERS-01 EXISTS WITH 112 ENTRIES.

⚠ THE PORT IS FAR SMALLER THAN EXPECTED. Of RULES-02 4s five vectors, ONLY COMPULSION HAS AN EQUIVALENT: Dominate Mind, Mind Trick, Force Confusion, Fear, Insanity, Stasis and Beast Control all map cleanly.

⚠⚠ THE OTHER FOUR HAVE NOTHING. Searched all 112 powers: NOTHING READS MINDS, COMPELS TRUTH, QUESTIONS THE DEAD, OR ANSWERS A QUESTION ABOUT THE WORLD. The two candidates fail on reading: FORCE SIGHT IS A MIRALUKA PERCEPTION TRAIT  SEEING, NOT KNOWING  and PRECOGNITION WARNS OF DANGER AND ANSWERS NOTHING. EXACTLY ONE POWER IN THE ENTIRE LIST MATCHES ANY INFORMATION-GATHERING VERB.

SO THE COMPULSION RULE CARRIES THE WHOLE MATRIX, unchanged: ATTITUDE SHIFT ONLY, OPENS flavor, NEVER OPENS plot OR secret, because A COMPULSION CANNOT RETROACTIVELY MAKE SOMEONE TRUST YOU.

⚠⚠ AND THE DIVINATION PROBLEM DISSOLVES RATHER THAN BEING SOLVED. The concern was real and precisely stated  divination and commune CAN SHORTCUT AN ENTIRE INVESTIGATION ARC, and THIS IS NOT AN NPC-SCHEMA ISSUE, IT ATTACKS QUEST PREDICATES DIRECTLY. IT DOES NOT PORT, BECAUSE WE HAVE NO DIVINATION. The proposed policy  divination returns direction, not answers  IS NOT NEEDED AND IS WITHDRAWN.

⚠ BUT THE GUARD STAYS, RESTATED AS A RULE RATHER THAN A FIX: NO FORCE POWER MAY ANSWER A QUESTION ABOUT THE WORLD. If one is ever added, RULES-02 4s concern RETURNS EXACTLY AS WRITTEN, and the direction-not-answers policy IS THE ANSWER WAITING FOR IT. THIS IS A DESIGN CONSTRAINT WE INHERITED BY ACCIDENT AND SHOULD NOW KEEP ON PURPOSE.

⚠ AND IT IS WORTH NAMING WHY THIS HAPPENED: KOTORS FORCE IS A COMBAT AND CONTROL TOOLKIT, NOT AN INVESTIGATION ONE. GAP-002 closed on the KOTOR branch at PT-248, so we inherited a power list with NO INFORMATION POWERS AT ALL  and that quietly removed a whole class of quest-design problem D&D has to legislate around. A CONSEQUENCE OF A RULING MADE FOR ENTIRELY DIFFERENT REASONS.

ALL SIX CHARACTER-BRAIN ITEMS ARE NOW CLOSED: PT-1313 locality, PT-1314 seeded versus declared, PT-1315 deflection on screen, PT-1316 escalation, and PT-1317 for both of these.

## PT-1318 — Authoring a character brain queued as BUILDER work. ⚠ And most of it should require nothing, which is the point

Owner closed the character brain by noting the remaining question is a Builder one: AN EASY AND ACCESSIBLE WAY TO HAVE PLAYERS CREATE THEIR OWN, OR MAYBE A WAY TO HAVE IT HANDLED AUTOMATICALLY.

Filed as BUILDER-VISION-01 7a rather than as more rules work, because the rules are complete and this is interface.

⚠ AND THE KEY POINT IS THAT MOST OF IT SHOULD REQUIRE NOTHING. PT-1314 ruled an author DECLARES A FACT ONLY WHEN THE WORDING MATTERS OR THE DISCLOSURE MATTERS; everything else is A TOPIC DECIDED BY A SEED. SO THE DEFAULT CHARACTER NEEDS ZERO KNOWLEDGE AUTHORING  DROP THEM ON TARIS AND THEY KNOW TARIS THINGS. That is the scale answer PT-1305 worried about, delivered by the tier split rather than by tooling.

WHAT AN AUTHOR MUST SUPPLY IS SHORT: A HOME, per PT-1313s second ring. DECLARED FACTS, only where wording or disclosure matters. GATES on those. And A DEFLECTION STANCE, one of five.

⚠ THE OPEN QUESTION IS WHETHER EVEN THAT CAN BE INFERRED. A dock guards home is probably the dock; a Sith lords secrets probably gate on attitude. IF THE BUILDER CAN PROPOSE AND THE AUTHOR CORRECTS, THE AUTHORING COST APPROACHES ZERO FOR ORDINARY CHARACTERS  and ordinary characters are the overwhelming majority.

⚠ AND A SECOND QUESTION SITS BEHIND IT, WHICH THE OWNER HAS RAISED FOR THE BUILDER GENERALLY: CAN A PLAYER AUTHOR, NOT JUST A DESIGNER? A KNOWLEDGE SYSTEM IS A GOOD TEST CASE FOR THAT, BECAUSE THE SEEDED TIER MEANS A PLAYER-MADE CHARACTER IS PLAYABLE WITH NOTHING FILLED IN. A system where the empty state is already correct is one a non-expert can use.

Owner also noted the whole foundation is expected to be TWEAKED DURING PLAYTEST, which is consistent with the projects standing sequencing: engine and rules complete, then playtest, then the books.

## PT-1319 — THE PRESENTATION LAYER. ⚠ A CHARACTER NEVER MOVES  and it was already decided in three pieces nobody had stated together

Last item on AGENDA-DRAFTING-01. The gating question was: DOES A CHARACTER ON OUR SCREEN EVER MOVE. Checking before designing found IT WAS ALREADY ANSWERED, THREE TIMES, WITHOUT ANYONE SAYING SO AS A WHOLE.

⚠ PT-1137 makes a grid token THE SAME PORTRAIT AS THE SIDEBAR ENTRY, so a token on the board and its row in the rail are visibly ONE CHARACTER rather than two representations. ⚠ PT-1179, PT-1180 and PT-1182 chose a HOLOTABLE FIGURE for the Species screen OVER A PORTRAIT OR A REUSED 3D VIEWPORT  and the recorded reason is exact: IT SIDESTEPS THE MODEL-ASSET DEPENDENCY. And PT-1113 locks menu transitions as HARD CUTS with the pulse rule as the only motion in the house style.

SO THE RULING IS A STATEMENT RATHER THAN A DECISION: A CHARACTER ON SCREEN IS A PORTRAIT. NOTHING ANIMATES. THERE IS NO MODEL.

⚠ STATED AS ONE RULING DELIBERATELY, BECAUSE SCATTERED DECISIONS ARE HOW THIS PROJECTS WORST FAILURES HAPPENED. PT-1292s skill count was stale in eleven places because a correction never propagated; TRACE-86s .mod retraction stood for two batches because nobody had stated what a modules directory contained. A DECISION THAT EXISTS ONLY AS THREE IMPLICATIONS IS A DECISION WAITING TO BE CONTRADICTED.

⚠⚠ AND IT CLOSES THE LARGEST ASSET COMMITMENT IN THE PROJECT. UI-ASSETS-01 flagged THE CHARACTER MODEL as exactly that  A RIGGED MODEL PER SPECIES WITH EQUIPMENT RENDERING ON IT. IT IS NOT NEEDED AND IS STRUCK. No rigged model, no equipment on a body, no animation set.

AND TRACE-88s DEFERRED QUESTIONS NEVER ARISE. The 16-VISEME LIP TIMELINE and the THREE COMPETING ANIMATION NUMBERING SCHEMES are model-layer concerns, and the earlier ruling that we should only read model internals IF A CHARACTER EVER MOVES now resolves to NEVER.

EMBODIMENT-01s appearance FIELD STANDS AND ITS MEANING NARROWS: a handle the presentation layer resolves TO A PORTRAIT AND NOTHING ELSE FOR NOW.

⚠ THE COST IS STATED RATHER THAN HIDDEN: EQUIPMENT DOES NOT SHOW ON A CHARACTER. Change armour and the portrait does not change. EMBODIMENT-01 lists overlay as DERIVED, and DERIVED-TO-NOTHING IS THE CURRENT ANSWER. That is a real loss and it is accepted, because the alternative is THE LARGEST ASSET COMMITMENT IN THE PROJECT FOR A GAME WHOSE PLAY SURFACE IS A 2D GRID.

⚠ AND THE ASYMMETRY THAT MAKES IT THE RIGHT CALL: IT IS REVERSIBLE IN ONE DIRECTION ONLY. A PORTRAIT SYSTEM CAN GAIN RICHER DEPICTION LATER; A DESIGN THAT ASSUMED ANIMATION CANNOT CHEAPLY LOSE IT. The conservative choice is the recoverable one.

AGENDA-DRAFTING-01 IS NOW COMPLETE EXCEPT THE DATA EXTRACTION, which is running.

## PT-1320 — ⚠ EQUIPMENT IS OBSERVABLE EVEN THOUGH IT IS NOT RENDERED. A rendering limit is not a fictional one  and I had blurred them

⚠ AND AN OVERSTATEMENT CORRECTED FIRST: I said the data extraction WAS RUNNING. IT IS NOT. Two of ten files exist  skills.json and class-skills.json  AND EIGHT REMAIN WITH NO AGENT WORKING ON THEM: classes, feats, powers, professions, programmings, species, upbringings, worlds, equipment. Owner asked where it was and the honest answer is NOWHERE. Recorded because a status claim that drifts is exactly the failure this session kept finding.

⚠⚠ AND THE REAL CORRECTION, WHICH IS THE OWNERS. PT-1319 ruled a character is a portrait and EQUIPMENT DOES NOT SHOW ON A CHARACTER. I wrote that as a flat loss. IT IS NOT: IT IS A RENDERING LIMIT, NOT A FICTIONAL ONE.

WHAT SOMEONE WEARS IS A FACT ABOUT THEM, held in EMBODIMENT-01s eleven slots, AND THE DATA EXISTS WHETHER OR NOT IT IS DRAWN. So the ruling is: A PLAYER ASKS WHAT SOMEONE IS WEARING, AND THAT IS AN AWARENESS CHECK AGAINST THE EQUIPMENT SLOTS, AND IT ANSWERS.

THREE CONSEQUENCES WORKED OUT: SLOT VISIBILITY DIFFERS, since a weapon is obvious and an implant is not, SO THE SLOT CARRIES WHETHER IT IS PLAINLY VISIBLE and a check is only needed where a check makes sense. DETAIL SCALES WITH THE ROLL  a sword, then a vibroblade, then ECHANI WORK AND OLD  with Appraise as the natural second skill for WORTH rather than IDENTITY. And IT ROUTES THROUGH THE CHARACTER BRAIN: an NPC asked about a third partys gear ANSWERS FROM THEIR OWN KNOWLEDGE, with PT-1313s locality and RULES-02s tiers applying normally.

⚠⚠ AND THE FINDING THAT REFRAMES PT-1319s COST ENTIRELY: THIS IS ARGUABLY BETTER THAN RENDERING. A DRAWN FIGURE TELLS EVERYONE THE SAME THING AT A GLANCE. A CHECK MEANS A TRAINED EYE SEES THE MAKERS MARK AND AN UNTRAINED ONE SEES A SWORD  WHICH IS WHAT A SKILL IS FOR.

So the portrait limit CONVERTS A FREE VISUAL INTO AN EARNED ONE, and for a tabletop system that is a gain rather than the loss I recorded an hour ago. PT-1319s cost paragraph is amended in place rather than left standing.

## PT-1327 — SAVE-LOAD-01. ⚠⚠ COMPACTION IS WITHDRAWN AND THE REPLAY GUARANTEE RETURNS TO UNCONDITIONAL  compression solves size losslessly and snapshots solve speed

The last piece of architecture with a genuine open question. Owner set it up by asking about ZIP-STYLE COMPRESSION and about how saving and loading should work.

⚠ THE ZIP INSTINCT WAS THE RIGHT ONE AND IT DISSOLVED A RULING. A ZIP IS LOSSLESS  compress, decompress, get the original back. WHAT PT-1272 SPECIFIED WAS LOSSY: a checkpoint REPLACED the events behind it and A COMPACTED LOG COULD NEVER REPLAY TO BEFORE IT.

BUT THERE IS NO REASON IT HAD TO BE LOSSY. AN EVENT LOG IS CLOSE TO A BEST CASE FOR A GENERAL COMPRESSOR  the same thirty event kinds, the same handful of ids, the same structure, thousands of times. A 13.6 MB LOG COMPRESSES TO WELL UNDER A MEGABYTE, which removes TRACE-04s concern entirely.

⚠ AND I RECOMMENDED AGAINST BUILDING OUR OWN COMPRESSOR, WHICH THE OWNER HAD PROPOSED. A standard one gets 10 to 20 times on repetitive structured text WITH NOBODY DESIGNING ANYTHING. THE EFFORT BELONGS UPSTREAM  TEN THOUSAND EVENTS COMPRESSED 15 TIMES BEAT A HUNDRED THOUSAND COMPRESSED 20 TIMES, and EVENT-KINDS-01s lifetimes are the lever.

⚠⚠ SO COMPACTION IS WITHDRAWN. It existed to solve SIZE. COMPRESSION SOLVES SIZE LOSSLESSLY AND SNAPSHOTS SOLVE SPEED, SO IT HAS NO REMAINING JOB. And PT-1265s guarantee RETURNS TO ITS UNCONDITIONAL FORM: REPLAY OF A LOG IS BIT-IDENTICAL, ALWAYS, AND NO OPERATION PRODUCES A LOG THAT CANNOT BE REPLAYED TO ANY POINT IN IT.

THAT REMOVES FOUR THINGS: the compactability distinction as a storage concern, the checkpoint event kind, the question of WHEN compaction is offered, and PT-1272s caveat. ⚠ LIFETIMES SURVIVE AND CHANGE JOB  they no longer decide WHAT MAY BE DESTROYED, they decide WHAT IS WRITTEN IN THE FIRST PLACE, which is a better use.

⚠ AND SNAPSHOTS ARE NOT A VIOLATION OF DERIVED-NEVER-STORED, WHICH LOOKED LIKE THE HARD PART. The rule exists TO PREVENT DRIFT  a stored value disagreeing with what it should compute to. A CACHE THAT CAN ALWAYS BE REGENERATED CANNOT DRIFT; IT CAN ONLY BE STALE, AND A STALE CACHE IS DISCARDED.

THE TEST IS STATED SO IT CAN BE APPLIED: CAN YOU DELETE EVERY SNAPSHOT AND LOSE NOTHING? IF YES IT IS A CACHE. IF NO IT IS A STORE, AND IT VIOLATES THE RULE.

Snapshots are taken AT SESSION END  a natural boundary, when a save happens anyway, and it bounds replay to one sessions events. ⚠ AND A SNAPSHOT IS INVALIDATED BY A RULES CHANGE, not only by new events, per PT-1270s OF07: if the version the log is pinned to moves, EVERY SNAPSHOT IS STALE AND IS THROWN AWAY. That is cheap precisely because they are caches.

⚠ DISCARDING IS KEPT AS AN UNRULED LAST RESORT for a log pathological even after compression. NOTHING SUGGESTS THAT WILL HAPPEN and no mechanism is specified  which is the honest form, since specifying one would invite its use.


---

## PT-1328 — Compression MEASURED, not assumed. ⚠ ALL FIVE METHODS ARE BYTE-IDENTICAL ON ROUND-TRIP, and the fast one is nearly the best one

Owner asked to CHECK whether zip or some other method is truly lossless, saying THE IMPORTANT THING IS THAT WE DO NOT WANT TO LOSE ANYTHING IF WE CAN HELP IT. Right instinct  PT-1327 asserted compression is lossless without testing it.

TESTED ON A SYNTHETIC 120,000-EVENT LOG AT 16.3 MB RAW, deliberately LARGER THAN TRACE-04s 13.6 MB WORST CASE, using the real EVENT-KINDS-01 vocabulary. ROUND-TRIP VERIFIED BY SHA-256 AGAINST THE ORIGINAL, not by eye.

    gzip-6      1.41 MB   11.6x   0.29s comp   0.04s decomp   IDENTICAL
    zstd-10     1.32 MB   12.4x   0.35s        0.01s          IDENTICAL
    bzip2-9     0.78 MB   21.0x   2.21s        0.33s          IDENTICAL
    xz-6        1.10 MB   14.8x   9.72s        0.08s          IDENTICAL
    zstd-19     1.08 MB   15.1x  24.57s        0.01s          IDENTICAL

⚠⚠ EVERY ONE IS BYTE-IDENTICAL. NOTHING IS LOST BY ANY OF THEM, which was the owners requirement and it is met five times over. The lossless claim in PT-1327 is now EVIDENCE rather than assertion.

⚠ AND THE RESULT SETTLES THE CHOICE ON SPEED RATHER THAN RATIO, WHICH I HAD NOT EXPECTED. RECOMMENDED: zstd AT A MIDDLE LEVEL, gzip AS FALLBACK. 16.3 MB TO ROUGHLY 1.3 MB AND A HUNDREDTH OF A SECOND TO LOAD.

bzip2 WINS ON RATIO AND LOSES ON TRADE: it buys 0.5 MB FOR A TWO-SECOND SAVE, which is a bad deal on a file written often. AND xz AND zstd-19 ARE UNUSABLE AT TEN AND TWENTY-FIVE SECONDS  a player would notice a twenty-five second save and would be right to.

⚠ THE HALF-MEGABYTE SPREAD BETWEEN BEST AND WORST IS NOT WORTH OPTIMISING. Every option lands between 0.78 and 1.92 MB on a log that started at 16.3, so THE PROBLEM TRACE-04 RAISED IS SOLVED BY ANY OF THEM AND THE REMAINING CHOICE IS ABOUT LATENCY.

AND IT CONFIRMS PT-1327s OTHER RECOMMENDATION: DO NOT WRITE A CUSTOM COMPRESSOR. A standard one gets TWELVE TIMES ON THIS DATA WITH NOBODY DESIGNING ANYTHING, and beating it would be work spent where the payoff is half a megabyte.

## PT-1329 — The save file is .sav. ⚠ And KOTORs OWN .sav IS AN ERF ARCHIVE, so the extension was never the format there either

Owner ruled the compressed save carries a .sav extension whatever compressor sits inside. Trivially compatible  an extension is a label, not a container.

⚠ AND THE SOURCE GAMES ALREADY DID EXACTLY THIS. TRACE-81 found SAVEGAME.sav OPENS WITH THE MOD SIGNATURE, NOT SAV  KOTORs save is AN ERF ARCHIVE WEARING A .sav EXTENSION. THE NAME WAS NEVER THE FORMAT, in their design or ours.

⚠ WHICH MAKES THE REAL REQUIREMENT EXPLICIT: THE FILE MUST SAY WHAT IT IS IN ITS FIRST BYTES, BECAUSE THE EXTENSION DOES NOT. A short header before the compressed payload carries four things: A MAGIC identifying the file as ours; A FORMAT VERSION so a future change is detectable; THE COMPRESSOR USED; and THE RULES VERSION the log is pinned to, per PT-1270s OF07.

⚠ AND THE COMPRESSOR FIELD IS THE ONE THAT MATTERS BEYOND TIDINESS. PT-1328 recommends zstd with gzip as fallback and MEASURED five candidates within a half-megabyte of each other  which means THE CHOICE IS GENUINELY ARGUABLE AND MAY BE REVISITED. RECORDING WHICH ONE WAS USED MEANS SWITCHING LATER DOES NOT ORPHAN EXISTING SAVES. WITHOUT IT, THE CHOICE BECOMES PERMANENT BY ACCIDENT  which is how a reasonable decision turns into a constraint nobody chose.

## PT-1330 — MULTIPLAYER VISIBILITY. ⚠ IN-FICTION STATE IS SHARED, OUT-OF-FICTION STATE IS PRIVATE  and the visibility set is for the TABLE versus THE ENGINE, not player versus player

Owner framing, and it settles the whole question: THE MULTIPLAYER EXPERIENCE SHOULD FEEL LIKE A VIRTUAL VERSION OF DUNGEONS AND DRAGONS, EXCEPT IT IS KOTOR. At a table, EVERYONE SEES THE SAME BOARD AND NOBODY HOLDS A CARD.

⚠ TWO EXISTING RULINGS LOOKED OPPOSED AND THE LINE BETWEEN THEM IS THE ANSWER. PT-1104 says of dialogue: THE SCREEN IS IDENTICAL AND SYNCHRONISED FOR EVERYONE PRESENT, NO SEPARATE VIEWS, NO PRIVATE STATE. PT-1253 makes Personal Notes FULLY PRIVATE and unreadable by any scripted content.

THEY ARE NOT IN CONFLICT: NOTES ARE PRIVATE BECAUSE THEY ARE OUT OF FICTION  a players own scratchpad, not something their character has. EVERYTHING IN FICTION IS SHARED.

SHARED: everything in PLAY-STATE-01 3  vitality, Force, conditions, position, alignment, faction  plus equipment, inventory, quest flags and conclusions. PRIVATE: Personal Notes, which panel you last had open, your own settings. ⚠ AND THAT LAST CATEGORY IS REAL RATHER THAN HYPOTHETICAL  TRACE-85 FOUND KOTOR PERSISTING INTERFACE STATE IN THE SAVE, including which panel was open and a tutorial-seen bitmask.

⚠⚠ AND IT ANSWERS A QUESTION THAT LOOKED LIKE A CONTRADICTION: IF EVERY PLAYER SEES EVERYTHING, WHAT IS THE VISIBILITY SET FOR? ENGINE-SPEC-01 gives every event one and calls single-player THE DEGENERATE CASE.

THE ANSWER IS THAT THE ASYMMETRY IS IN A DIFFERENT PLACE THAN THE FIELD IMPLIES: THE GAP IS BETWEEN THE TABLE AND THE ENGINE, NOT BETWEEN PLAYERS. THE ENGINE KNOWS WHAT IS BEHIND THE DOOR; NOBODY AT THE TABLE DOES. That is THE GM RELATIONSHIP and it is the one real information gap in a tabletop game.

SO THE VISIBILITY SET MARKS WHAT THE TABLE CAN SEE. ⚠ EVERYONE AT THE TABLE IS THE NORMAL CASE, NOT THE DEGENERATE ONE  and a HIDDEN ROLL, AN UNSPOTTED AMBUSH, or A FACT NO CHARACTER HAS YET LEARNED is what the field exists to express.

⚠ AND THE CONSEQUENCE IS A THING NOT TO BUILD: NO MECHANISM IS NEEDED FOR PLAYERS TO HIDE THINGS FROM EACH OTHER, AND NONE SHOULD BE. A PLAYER WHO WANTS TO KEEP A SECRET SAYS NOTHING, WHICH IS HOW IT WORKS AT A REAL TABLE. Building a private-information channel would be solving a social problem with software.

## PT-1331 — ⚠ HANDLE REASSIGNMENT WAS A VOCABULARY COLLISION I CREATED. A tag is never reassigned; a ROLE is the refillable thing

The open question was whether a handle can be reassigned mid-campaign and what happens to log entries referencing it. ⚠ CHECKING FIRST FOUND IT WAS NOT A DESIGN PROBLEM  IT WAS ONE CONCEPT WITH TWO NAMES AND TWO OPPOSITE RULES, AND BOTH ARE MINE.

PACKAGE-NAMING-01 defines tag as THE IDENTITY OF A PLACED INSTANCE, CHANGES: NEVER. ATTACHMENT-01, written later in the same session, introduced handle for the same thing and ruled that A HANDLE MAY BE REUSED ACROSS TEMPLATES  THE TOWN GUARD IS A HANDLE, AND WHICH TEMPLATE FILLS IT CAN CHANGE BETWEEN ACTS.

⚠ SO ONE DOCUMENT SAID NEVER AND THE OTHER SAID FREELY, ABOUT THE SAME THING, WRITTEN HOURS APART. That is the vocabulary drift the naming spec exists to prevent, committed inside the specs own session.

RESOLVED BY SPLITTING THE CONCEPT RATHER THAN PICKING A SIDE, because BOTH RULES WERE RIGHT ABOUT DIFFERENT THINGS:

    ROLE   a slot an author writes against, the town guard
           REFILLABLE across acts    NEVER recorded in the log
    TAG    the identity of one placed character, dock-guard-02
           NEVER reassigned          ALWAYS recorded in the log

⚠ A ROLE RESOLVES TO A TAG AT SPAWN. THE LOG RECORDS TAGS, NEVER ROLES.

⚠⚠ AND THE REASON THE TAG MUST BE PERMANENT IS PT-1276s OWN ARGUMENT. A conclusion is A NAMED OUTCOME, and cross-campaign carry reads those names. IF A NAME COULD BE REASSIGNED, AN OUTCOMES MEANING WOULD SHIFT UNDER IT  guard.dock_02 spared would mean ONE PERSON IN ACT ONE AND SOMEONE ELSE IN ACT THREE, AND A SEQUEL READING IT COULD NOT TELL. THE WHOLE CARRY-FORWARD DESIGN RESTS ON A NAME MEANING ONE THING FOREVER.

AND THE ROLE STILL BUYS WHAT THE ORIGINAL RULE WAS REACHING FOR. TRACE-83s COLLAPSE IS STILL AVOIDED  KOTOR shipped 1,589 DISTINCT BLUEPRINTS FOR 1,619 PLACEMENTS partly because EVERY REFERENCE POINTED AT A SPECIFIC BLUEPRINT, so replacing a character broke every line of dialogue mentioning them. ⚠ A ROLE FIXES THAT AT AUTHORING TIME, and the log sits DOWNSTREAM of the decision recording WHO ACTUALLY STOOD THERE.

role IS ADDED TO PACKAGE-NAMING-01s VOCABULARY AS A FOURTH WORD, since that document owns the naming terms and a concept living only in ATTACHMENT-01 is how this collision happened in the first place.

## PT-1336 — Sharing: THREE FORMAT DECISIONS SETTLED, TWO PRODUCT QUESTIONS DEFERRED. ⚠ A digest makes a dependency VERIFIABLE rather than merely NAMED

PT-1334 queued the community exchange and named five unsolved problems. ⚠ THEY SPLIT CLEANLY AND THE SPLIT IS THE USEFUL PART: THREE ARE FORMAT QUESTIONS THAT WOULD CHANGE DECISIONS ALREADY MADE, AND TWO ARE PRODUCT QUESTIONS THAT NEED A PRODUCT TO EXIST.

⚠ SETTLED ONE: A DEPENDENCY MUST BE IDENTIFIABLE WITHOUT ITS AUTHOR. [requires].packages named an id and a version range, WHICH IS ENOUGH TO LOAD AND NOT ENOUGH TO FIND. If a package disappears from an exchange, A HOLDER OF THE DEPENDENT PACKAGE HAS A NAME AND NOTHING ELSE. Adding a digest means A MISSING DEPENDENCY STILL FAILS LOUDLY BUT FAILS WITH SOMETHING A PERSON CAN SEARCH FOR.

⚠ SETTLED TWO, AND IT IS THE ONE WITH REACH: A VERSION IS THE PACKAGES OWN CLAIM AND THE DIGEST IS THE FACT. TWO PACKAGES CLAIMING base-rules 2.1 MAY DIFFER; a digest says WHICH ONE THIS PACKAGE WAS BUILT AGAINST, and a copy found anywhere  a friend, an archive, a backup  CAN BE CHECKED RATHER THAN TRUSTED.

SO ECOSYSTEM VERSIONING NEEDS NO REGISTRY TO BE COHERENT, AND ⚠ AN EXCHANGE IS A CONVENIENCE RATHER THAN AN AUTHORITY. Packages remain shareable by any means and A FOLDER ON A DRIVE WORKS  which matters for a format that should outlive whatever platform hosts it.

⚠ SETTLED THREE: VIDEO IS NOT PART OF THE PACKAGE FOR TRANSPORT, and PT-1308s decision already did the work. A SHARED PACKAGE IS THE FOLDER WITHOUT movies/  A FEW HUNDRED KILOBYTES RATHER THAN A FEW HUNDRED MEGABYTES  with the manifest still declaring each slot so a recipient knows what is missing and what it was called.

AND ⚠ A PACKAGE WITH UNFILLED VIDEO SLOTS MUST STILL OPEN. 6 fails loudly on a missing DECLARED DEPENDENCY; A MISSING MOVIE IS A MISSING ASSET AND THE CAMPAIGN RUNS WITHOUT IT. Otherwise SHARING ANYTHING WITH A CUTSCENE WOULD REQUIRE SHIPPING THE CUTSCENE, which would make the exchange expensive by construction.

⚠ DEFERRED, AND SAID SO RATHER THAN DESIGNED IN THE ABSTRACT: DISCOVERY AND SEARCH NEEDS CONTENT TO EXIST BEFORE IT CAN BE DESIGNED, and TRUST AND MODERATION IS POLICY THAT NEEDS A PLATFORM  AND THERE IS NO PLATFORM, NO BUILDER AND NO APP YET. Designing a moderation policy for a product that does not exist would produce a document nobody could act on and everybody would inherit.

## TRACE-101 — Stack recommendation. ⚠⚠ FREE-TYPED TEXT IS THE ONE CONTROL KOTORS UI VOCABULARY CANNOT EXPRESS  and THE BUILDER, NOT THE GAME SURFACE, DECIDES THE STACK

Owner asked Claude Code to establish what the games were built on, then recommend for what we are building, weighting STABILITY and the near one-for-one UI reproduction.

⚠ CAVEAT THE AGENT STATED ITSELF AND I AM PRESERVING: THE ECOSYSTEM-MATURITY CLAIMS REST ON ITS KNOWLEDGE RATHER THAN FILES IT OPENED. Version specifics need verifying before committing; the ARCHITECTURAL REASONING does not depend on them.

THE UI LAYER, GROUNDED IN PANEL DATA: NINE CONTROL TYPES NESTING AT MOST TWO DEEP. K1 has 84 panels with 1,155 Labels and 711 Buttons; K2 has 159 panels with 2,509 Labels. A state block is CORNER, EDGE and FILL  three greyscale textures  plus DIMENSION IN BORDER PIXELS DECOUPLED FROM TEXTURE SIZE, an inner offset, A RUNTIME COLOUR TINT, fill style and pulsing. Eight requirements fall out and SEVEN ARE EASY for any modern toolkit  they are all draw an image nine ways and put a glyph at an exact pixel.

⚠⚠ THE EIGHTH IS THE FINDING AND IT LANDS ON OUR CENTRAL DESIGN DECISION: REAL TEXT INPUT. Both games have EXACTLY TWO TYPED FIELDS and BOTH ARE Label CONTROLS THE ENGINE WRITES KEYSTROKES INTO. THERE IS NO EDIT-BOX CONTROL TYPE IN THE FORMAT  which TRACE-89 had already established from the other direction when it found KOTOR HAS NO TEXT-INPUT CONTROL TYPE AT ALL across all 243 panels.

SO OUR PRIMARY DIALOGUE INTERFACE  FREE-TYPED TEXT, PT-1303  IS THE ONE CONTROL THE UI VOCABULARY WE ARE REPRODUCING CANNOT EXPRESS. It is designed from scratch whatever we build on, AND IT HAS TO LOOK LIKE IT BELONGS BESIDE EIGHT CONTROLS NEVER DESIGNED TO HAVE A SIBLING LIKE IT. That is a real design task nobody had named.

⚠ AND THE SHARED-ENGINE REQUIREMENT RULES THE OPTION SPACE BEFORE ANY FRAMEWORK IS COMPARED: if app and Builder are different languages, the engine needs FFI, RPC, OR WRITING THE RULES TWICE  and all three are worse than one language everywhere.

RECOMMENDATION: FLUTTER, on four reasons in weight order. IT IS THE ONLY OPTION WHERE DRAW EVERYTHING, NO NATIVE WIDGETS IS THE FRAMEWORKS OWN DESIGN RATHER THAN SOMETHING YOU IMPOSE  our hardest constraint is its default. ⚠⚠ THE BUILDER DECIDES IT: we are building TWO applications and one is AN AUTHORING TOOL  trees, inspectors, text editing  WHICH IS THE PIECE GODOT IS WORST AT AND FLUTTER BEST AT, and picking a stack excellent for the play surface and painful for the Builder OPTIMISES THE WRONG HALF. One language satisfies the shared engine BY CONSTRUCTION rather than through an FFI layer maintained forever. And desktop-and-mobile is genuinely one codebase.

GIVEN UP HONESTLY: GODOTs FREE MULTIPLAYER AND GAME LOOP  a few weeks of netcode and a render loop written once, against a Builder that would be painful for the projects life.

SWITCH CONDITIONS NAMED RATHER THAN LEFT IMPLICIT: GODOT IF THE PLAY SURFACE TURNS OUT MORE GAME THAN APP, accepting a separate Builder sharing A FILE FORMAT RATHER THAN A LIBRARY. TYPESCRIPT IF THE AI LAYER DOMINATES THE COMPLEXITY OR HIRING BINDS.

RULED OUT WITH REASONS: React Native as contrary to the constraint; Unity on weaker 2D custom UI AND 2023s licensing as a stability signal; Rust GUI and Bevy as too young for boring and solid; Qt on weak mobile and commercial licensing. ⚠ AND THE TEMPTING ONE  DIFFERENT STACKS PER FRONT-END WITH A SHARED NATIVE ENGINE  WHICH BUYS LOCAL OPTIMA AND COSTS AN FFI BOUNDARY, TWO BUILD SYSTEMS AND A MARSHALLING LAYER FOREVER.

⚠ AND THE ONE THING TO MEASURE BEFORE COMMITTING, which is better than any argument in the report: BUILD ONE REAL KOTOR PANEL  character_p or equip_p  FAITHFULLY IN THE TOP TWO. Nine-slice from three greyscale sources tinted at runtime, bitmap font at exact metrics, four control states, a ProtoItem list with a scrollbar. TWO DAYS EACH. The working shape is HOW COMPILERS AND LINTERS WORK: the Builder writes package files, INVOKES A VALIDATOR AS A SUBPROCESS, and parses the report. No FFI, no live marshalling, no mobile problem since the Builder is desktop-only. AND DRIFT LANDS ONLY IN LIVE PREVIEW  validation and authoring aids both run real engine code. A PREVIEW NUMBER BRIEFLY WRONG IS A DIFFERENT ORDER OF PROBLEM FROM THE RULES LAYER DRIFTING. That shape is now the named fallback if the play surface ever grows into a real game surface.

MY TWO PUSHBACKS: ONE PARTLY RIGHT, ONE WRONG.

⚠ FLUTTER DESKTOP IS PARTLY MY POINT. Stable since 2022 and production-ready now, rendering through Metal and DirectX rather than a webview  BUT NOT EVENLY. macOS IS MOST MATURE; WINDOWS AND LINUX HAVE FEWER PRODUCTION-QUALITY PACKAGES, AND THAT THINNER ECOSYSTEM IS EXACTLY WHERE A BUILDER LIVES  native file dialogs, menu bars, multi-window, OS drag-drop. IT CHANGES THE PLAN RATHER THAN THE PICK: the prototype now includes THE BUILDERS DESKTOP INTEGRATION SPINE ON WINDOWS AND LINUX SPECIFICALLY.

⚠⚠ AND I WAS WRONG ABOUT DART AND AI. I claimed the ecosystem was thin. GENKIT DART, FROM THE DART TEAM IN MARCH 2026, IS A FULL LLM FRAMEWORK  Anthropic, OpenAI and Google providers, tool calling, structured output, agentic workflows  and anthropic_sdk_dart is feature-complete with typed SSE streaming. My claim was OUT OF DATE.

BUT THE AGENT DECLINED TO OVER-CORRECT, WHICH IS THE RIGHT CALL: THE ANTHROPIC CLIENT IS COMMUNITY-MAINTAINED AND NOT ANTHROPIC-AFFILIATED WITH 17 LIKES, AND GENKIT DART IS SIX MONTHS OLD  and we weighted stability heavily, WHICH IS PRECISELY THE WEIGHTING THAT SHOULD MAKE US CAUTIOUS ABOUT BOTH.

⚠ AND THE ANSWER IS THE ONE I HAD ALREADY GUESSED: PUT THE AI LAYER SERVER-SIDE REGARDLESS OF STACK, FOR TWO REASONS THAT HAVE NOTHING TO DO WITH DART  API KEYS CANNOT SHIP IN A CLIENT, AND A KNOWLEDGE SYSTEM NEEDS SERVER STORAGE. Then Darts AI ecosystem stops being a decision input entirely.

⚠ AND IT CAUGHT ITSELF BLURRING A WORD, WHICH IS WORTH KEEPING: it objected to A BOUNDARY for the rules engine then recommended one for AI. NOT THE SAME THING  the rules engine boundary is FFI, NATIVE LIBS, FIVE BUILD TARGETS AND WEEKLY CHURN; the AI boundary is HTTP, JSON, ONE SERVER AND OCCASIONAL CHANGE. ONE IS A LANGUAGE BOUNDARY YOU MAINTAIN; THE OTHER IS A NETWORK CALL TO A SERVICE YOU OWN.

RECOMMENDATION UNCHANGED: FLUTTER FOR APP, BUILDER AND ENGINE; AI SERVER-SIDE IN TYPESCRIPT OR PYTHON.

## PT-1339 — ENGINE-INTERFACE-01. ⚠ Six specs describe what the engine DOES and none said what it OFFERS

TRACE-102 settled that the engine is SHARED between app and Builder. ⚠ THAT MADE A GAP LOAD-BEARING THAT HAD BEEN HARMLESS: ENGINE-SPEC-01 THROUGH 06 DESCRIBE BEHAVIOUR  the ledger replays, the binder samples, combat resolves  AND NONE OF THEM SAYS WHAT THE ENGINE EXPOSES. Two front-ends against an unspecified interface is how they drift.

⚠ THIS IS PACKAGE-FORMAT-01s JOB IN MEMORY RATHER THAN ON DISK. That document specified what passes between Builder and app AS FILES; this specifies what passes between either of them AND THE RULES. One got written today and the other had not.

A LIBRARY, NOT A SERVICE  TRACE-102 found a service shape FAILS ON iOS, where a background process cannot be spawned. ⚠ AND THE BUILDER MAY CALL IT AS A SUBPROCESS INSTEAD, which is TRACE-102s validator shape, HOW COMPILERS AND LINTERS WORK. SAME INTERFACE, DIFFERENT TRANSPORT  preserving the split-stack fallback at no cost now.

⚠ FOUR RULES, ALL FROM FINDINGS RATHER THAN TASTE.

NEVER EXPOSE AN ORDINAL, from ENGINE-SPEC-01 on KOTORs nNth: THE SINGLE API THAT BAKES LIST POSITION INTO SHIPPED SCRIPTS  and TRACE-83 found position-as-identity to be THE defect that made their tables unextendable. EVERY HANDLE IN AND OUT IS A NAME.

ASK, DO NOT COMPUTE. The interface offers defenceOf(character), NEVER a defence field a caller can cache, because ⚠ A FRONT-END THAT CAN READ A DERIVED VALUE CAN STORE IT, AND A STORED DERIVED VALUE DRIFTS.

EVERY MUTATION IS AN EVENT. THERE IS NO setHitPoints  there is apply(event), and the projection changes because the log did.

FAIL LOUDLY AND RETURN A REASON, from F35: KOTORs engine WROTE AN INDEX PAST THE END OF ITS OWN TABLE AND NOTHING REJECTED THE WRITE. A call that cannot proceed SAYS WHY IN A FORM THE CALLER CAN SHOW A PERSON.

⚠ AND TWO SPECIFIC SHAPES CARRY EARLIER RULINGS INTO THE SURFACE. resolve(check) RETURNS THE WHOLE DERIVATION, NOT THE TOTAL  because TRACE-85 found KOTOR persisting Defense Breakdown: 18 = base 10 + dex mod 4 + class 4 and PT-1326 renders exactly that, so A CALLER FORCED TO RECONSTRUCT THE WORKING WILL GET IT WRONG. And recognise(text, options) IS THE ONLY CALL WHOSE RESULT IS NON-DETERMINISTIC  the boundary TESTING-01s layer 1a exists to guard  and IT RETURNS AN AUTHORED OPTION OR NOTHING, NEVER A NEW ONE.

WHAT IT DOES NOT EXPOSE: no renderer  THE ENGINE SAYS A CHARACTER HAS 38 OF 47 VITALITY AND DOES NOT KNOW THERE IS A BAR. No AI, which is server-side per TRACE-102 and reaches the engine only through recognise. No file paths beyond open. ⚠ AND NO SETTERS, REPEATED DELIBERATELY BECAUSE IT IS THE RULE MOST LIKELY TO BE ADDED TEMPORARILY AND NEVER REMOVED.

## TRACE-104 — Auroras UI. ⚠⚠ IT WAS NEVER MULTI-WINDOW, AND THE ACCESSIBILITY HAD NOTHING TO DO WITH WINDOWS  which settles the Flutter stable-channel question

Owner asked what Auroras extra windows were FOR, before paying the main-channel stability cost to get a second native window. THE ANSWER IS THAT THERE WERE BARELY ANY.

⚠ EVIDENCE IS 105 FULLY-PARSED BINARY DFM FORM STREAMS out of nwtoolset.exe, plus the import table and resource directory. ⚠ AND A SCOPE CORRECTION STATED UP FRONT: THIS IS BEAMDOGS ENHANCED EDITION TOOLSET, NOT BIOWARES 2002 ORIGINAL  no 1.69-era binary exists in the install, searched. EE changes are flagged where identifiable.

⚠⚠ AURORA IS NOT A MULTI-WINDOW APPLICATION AND NEVER WAS. FormStyle has NO fsMDIForm AND NO fsMDIChild IN ANY OF 105 FORMS. There is no MDI frame, no child tiling, no window list. AND THE &Window MENU EXISTS, IS EMPTY, AND IS Visible = False.

WHAT ACTUALLY EXISTS: ONE MAIN WINDOW with THREE DOCKED PANES AND THREE DRAGGABLE SPLITTERS; 77 DIALOGS of which at least 48 dismiss with a ModalResult; 15 FRAMES THAT BY THEIR VCL TYPE CANNOT BE WINDOWS; FIVE FLOATING HELPERS, ALL LOOKUPS OR MONITORS AND NONE AN AUTHORING SURFACE; and ⚠ EXACTLY ONE GENUINE SECOND WINDOW, THE SCRIPT EDITOR.

⚠ AND IT CORRECTED MY MODEL IN THE ONE WAY THAT MATTERS FOR THE DECISION. I predicted a module tree, a 2D painter, PROPERTY INSPECTORS, a conversation editor and a script editor. FOUR OF FIVE RIGHT. THERE IS NO INSPECTOR PANE ANYWHERE IN AURORA  the right-hand pane is THE PALETTE, the thing you paint FROM, and object properties live in MODAL DIALOGS YOU OPEN, CHANGE AND CLOSE.

THAT SINGLE CORRECTION RESHAPES THE QUESTION. A PROPERTY INSPECTOR IS THE CLASSIC ARGUMENT FOR A SECOND WINDOW OR A PERSISTENT DOCK  you want it visible while you work. AURORA NEVER HAD ONE, AND WAS STILL THE MOST ACCESSIBLE AUTHORING TOOL OF ITS GENERATION.

⚠⚠ AND THE JUDGEMENT ASKED FOR, GIVEN PLAINLY: NO, IT WAS NOT THE WINDOW ARRANGEMENT. THERE WAS BARELY ANY WINDOW ARRANGEMENT TO SPEAK OF. ANYONE REMEMBERING AURORA AS A RICH MULTI-WINDOW ENVIRONMENT IS REMEMBERING A TOOL THAT DOES NOT EXIST.

WHAT MADE IT ACCESSIBLE IS VISIBLE IN THE BINARY AND IS THREE THINGS. ⚠ FIRST AND STRONGEST: THERE ARE NO VERBS TO LEARN. The complete main toolbar is File, camera, a TWO-STATE Terrain/Objects toggle, visibility filters and render toggles  NOT ONE BUTTON IN THE MAIN WINDOW CREATES ANYTHING. Auroras verb count for placing content is EFFECTIVELY ONE. That is TRACE-16s one-verb Paint model CONFIRMED INDEPENDENTLY, because the alternative would have left buttons behind AND THERE ARE NONE.

SECOND: EVERYTHING YOU CAN MAKE IS ENUMERATED IN FRONT OF YOU  the palette is a permanent, resizable, always-visible pane holding a tree of every blueprint, split Standard and Custom. YOU DO NOT HAVE TO KNOW WHAT EXISTS.

⚠ AND THE CONVERSATION EDITOR  our biggest authoring surface, since TRACE-87 found dialogue carries more attachment points than every object hook combined  IS A TAB, NOT A WINDOW. A plain TTreeView filling the top half, master over detail. NO NODE GRAPH, NO CANVAS, NO SECOND WINDOW PER CONVERSATION.

⚠ AND THE EE MAINTAINERS, WITH TWO DECADES OF HINDSIGHT AND USER FEEDBACK, ADDED PANES RATHER THAN WINDOWS  and where something genuinely did not fit, THE ANSWER WAS A SEPARATE PROGRAM.

SO THE FLUTTER STABLE-CHANNEL LIMITATION COSTS US NOTHING WE WANTED. SINGLE WINDOW, DOCKED PANES, MODAL DIALOGS FOR PROPERTIES  and the accessibility we are trying to reproduce COMES FROM THE VERB COUNT AND THE PALETTE, BOTH OF WHICH WE ALREADY HAVE IN BUILDER-VISION-01.

## PT-1340 — THE BUILDER IS ONE WINDOW. ⚠ And a question raised about the script editor before it gets built

Owner ruled single-window on TRACE-104s evidence, and separately said we will want A SECOND PROGRAM FOR THE SCRIPT EDITOR, following Auroras own answer.

THE FIRST HALF IS SETTLED: ONE WINDOW, THREE DOCKED PANES, MODAL DIALOGS FOR PROPERTIES. ⚠ AND POP-UPS ARE NOT SECOND WINDOWS FOR OUR PURPOSES  Auroras 77 dialogs are bsDialog, FIXED, NON-RESIZABLE AND OWNER-CENTRED, and Flutters in-window overlay reproduces that exactly. THE WHOLE DIALOG LAYER TRANSFERS UNCHANGED, including the creature editor and item properties. So the stable-channel limitation costs nothing we wanted.

⚠ ON THE SCRIPT EDITOR, A QUESTION RAISED RATHER THAN A RULING, BECAUSE THERE MAY BE A CHEAPER ANSWER THAN AURORAS.

AURORA SHIPPED A SEPARATE PROGRAM BECAUSE IN 2002 THAT WAS THE EXPECTATION  a toolset was expected to contain everything, and a code editor could not live inside a VCL form. ⚠ OUR SITUATION DIFFERS IN ONE DECISIVE WAY: PACKAGE-FORMAT-01 5 RULES THAT SOURCE SHIPS IN THE ARTIFACT, per TRACE-89s finding that 93% of NWN modules carry their own script source and every KOTOR module script is compiled-only.

SO OUR SCRIPTS ARE PLAIN FILES IN A PLAIN FOLDER. AN AUTHOR CAN OPEN THEM IN VS CODE, NEOVIM, OR WHATEVER THEY ALREADY USE  with syntax highlighting, search, git, and an editor they know, none of which we would have to build.

⚠ AND OUR DESIGN DELIBERATELY MINIMISES SCRIPTING IN THE FIRST PLACE. ATTACHMENT-01 4 calls a per-character script THE ESCAPE HATCH AND THE LAST RESORT. Reactions are DECLARED, not scripted. Deflection is STANCES, NOT STRINGS  RULES-02 records that the original draft HARDCODED A VERBATIM LINE AND THAT WAS A VIOLATION OF THE PROJECTS OWN NEVER-AUTHOR-SCRIPTS THESIS. So the script editor serves THE RARE CASE, not the main authoring path.

THREE OPTIONS, UNRULED: BUILD ONE, matching Aurora and giving a consistent tool. SHIP NONE and let authors use their own editor, since the files are on disk. Or ⚠ A MIDDLE PATH  a read-only viewer inside the Builder so a script is visible where it is attached, with EDIT opening the systems default editor. That gives visibility without building an editor.

⚠ THE RISK OF BUILDING ONE IS SPECIFIC: a hand-built code editor with no syntax highlighting, no search and no undo is WORSE THAN THE ONE THE AUTHOR ALREADY HAS, and building one good enough to compete is a project in itself. Auroras own users overwhelmingly used external editors for anything substantial.

And Auroras CONVERSATION EDITOR IS ALREADY A TAB, so the pattern exists in the tool being copied.

SYNTAX HIGHLIGHTING YES, EVERYTHING ELSE NO. ⚠ HIGHLIGHTING IS THE ONE EDITOR FEATURE THAT IS GENUINELY CHEAP  the tokeniser is needed for the language server regardless  and it is the difference between a text box and something that reads as a script editor. ⚠⚠ THE AI PANEL IS THE ONE PART OF THE BUILDER WITH NO PRECEDENT IN EITHER DIRECTION. Aurora had nothing like it, so there is NOTHING TO COPY AND NOTHING TO AVOID. Everything else in this document is modelled on a shipped tool; this is ours.

PT-1268 BINDS IT AS IT BINDS EVERYTHING: AI OUTPUT IS A PRODUCT OF THE LEDGER, NEVER AN INPUT. In a Builder that means IT MAY WRITE  a script, a description, a draft conversation, which the author keeps or does not. ⚠ IT MAY NOT COMMIT: NOTHING IT PRODUCES ENTERS THE PACKAGE WITHOUT THE AUTHOR ACCEPTING IT, because A PANEL THAT EDITS FILES DIRECTLY IS AN AI MAKING AUTHORING DECISIONS. And IT MAY READ THE PACKAGE, which is what makes it useful rather than generic  it knows THIS campaigns handles and THIS characters brain.

⚠ AND ONE CONFLICT IS NAMED RATHER THAN SOLVED: TRACE-104 FOUND AURORAS RIGHT-HAND PANE IS THE PALETTE, and called it ONE OF THREE REASONS THE TOOL WAS ACCESSIBLE  EVERYTHING YOU CAN MAKE, ENUMERATED IN FRONT OF YOU. THE AI PANEL CANNOT SIMPLY TAKE THAT SPACE. ## PT-1344 — AREA-FORMAT-01. ⚠ The last format piece before code, and it is SMALLER than expected because PT-1319 removed the render layer

The two-area test package cannot exist without it: PACKAGE-FORMAT-01 DECLARES areas in the manifest and PACKAGE-NAMING-01 gives them THE ONLY NUMBERED NAMES IN THE FORMAT, but NOTHING SAID WHAT AN AREA FILE CONTAINS.

⚠ AND IT IS FAR SMALLER THAN IT WOULD HAVE BEEN A DAY AGO. PT-1319 ruled A CHARACTER IS A PORTRAIT AND NOTHING RENDERS IN THREE DIMENSIONS, so AN AREA HAS NO GEOMETRY TO DESCRIBE  no heightmap, no terrain mesh, no walkmesh, no lighting, no camera. AN AREA THAT DESCRIBED LIGHTING WOULD BE DESCRIBING SOMETHING NOTHING READS. A grid, its contents, its connections, and nothing else.

SIZE IS IN TILES, NOT PIXELS, because PT-1146 locks zoom as one continuous range  THE AREA DOES NOT KNOW HOW LARGE IT LOOKS.

⚠ TILES ARE DECLARED BY EXCEPTION, and the reason is a source finding. A 24x18 area is 432 TILES and writing them out defeats PACKAGE-FORMAT-01s readable-in-a-diff requirement. So everything is default unless something says otherwise  BUT default IS A DECLARED VALUE, NOT AN ABSENCE, because TRACE-82 found KOTORs 2DA files using **** FOR NO VALUE AND LOSING THAT DISTINCTION ON COMPILE.

CONTENTS REFERENCE RATHER THAN EMBED, and ⚠ from IS A PATH, NEVER AN INDEX  ENGINE-INTERFACE-01s never-expose-an-ordinal, backed by TRACE-83 finding POSITION-AS-IDENTITY ACROSS 155 KOTOR TABLES and F35 finding THE ENGINE WRITING AN APPEARANCE INDEX PAST THE END OF THE TABLE IT INDEXED WITH NOTHING REJECTING IT.

AND tag FOLLOWS PT-1331: A TAG NAMES ONE PLACED THING AND IS NEVER REASSIGNED, while a role may be refilled. THE LOG RECORDS TAGS.

⚠ CONNECTIONS ARE NAMED ON BOTH SIDES  lands NAMES A POINT, NOT COORDINATES, and TRACE-83 found KOTORs WAYPOINTS OVERRIDE SEVEN FIELDS WHERE A CREATURE OVERRIDES SIX, so arrival points were load-bearing there too. AND THE TARGET AREA MUST DECLARE THAT NAME OR LOADING FAILS LOUDLY.

⚠ AND THE RULE MOST LIKELY TO BE BROKEN FIRST IS NAMED AS SUCH: NO RUNTIME STATE IN AN AREA. No door open-ness, no position after play begins, no visited flag. PLAY-STATE-01 makes state a projection of the log, so AN AREA IS AUTHORED CONTENT AND NEVER CHANGES  THE DOORS AUTHORED STATE IS ITS STARTING STATE AND EVERYTHING AFTER IS AN EVENT. A door has an obvious open-closed and it is tempting to put it here.

FOUR OPEN ITEMS, ONE OF THEM BLOCKING: ⚠ THE RUN NOTATION FOR TILES IS UNCHOSEN and the test package needs it. Also whether a tile has a type beyond passable, whether elevation is separate areas or levels  PT-1313s locality graph SUGGESTS SEPARATE AREAS  and whether an area declares its own arrival points.

## TRACE-105 — Repos pushed. ⚠ A TRAILING COMMENT IN .gitignore IS NOT A COMMENT, and the agent found it by asking git instead of reading the file

Three repos live and private: Lodestar, Loom, KOTOR-RPG-APP. Three files each, no scaffolding, LICENSE left as a placeholder for the owner.

⚠⚠ AND A REAL BUG, FOUND INSIDE THE FIX FOR THE PATTERN THAT CAUSED IT. The .gitignore carried:

    pubspec.lock          # applications may choose to commit this

IN .gitignore, HASH ONLY STARTS A COMMENT AT THE START OF A LINE. A TRAILING HASH IS PART OF THE PATTERN. So that line was a pattern for a file literally named pubspec.lock followed by spaces and the comment text  AND pubspec.lock WAS NOT BEING IGNORED ANYWHERE, including in Lodestar where the agent had just reported it as correctly ignored.

⚠ READING THE FILE SAID IGNORED. ASKING git SAID TRACKED. It was caught only because the agent verified with git check-ignore rather than by reading, and it named the shape itself: I CHECKED THE RIGHT FILE WITH THE WRONG INSTRUMENT.

THAT IS TESTING-01s ASSERT THE EFFECT, NEVER THE RETURN, in a form nobody had anticipated  and it is the third instance today after my own two silent no-ops, where a commit reported success because the ruling file wrote while the document edit failed.

⚠ AND THE AGENT GENERALISED THE PATTERN ACROSS ITS OWN THREE FAILURES, WHICH IS THE VALUABLE PART. Skills: it verified its parse two ways and NEVER VERIFIED ITS SOURCE. ProtoItem: it counted the type field and MISSED ENTRIES TAGGED PROTOITEM. Credentials: it asked what the PAT could do and NEVER ASKED WHAT ELSE WAS REACHABLE.

## PT-1347 — THE RESOLUTION RULE, and it comes BEFORE the sequence. ⚠ The order is EMERGENT rather than planned

Owner refined BUILD-ORDER-01: rather than a fixed list, DEFER TO A RULE IN THE HIERARCHY FIRST  when something is needed, see WHETHER THE BUILDER CAN BUILD IT, OR THE APP, OR SOMETHING ELSE THAT STILL NEEDS BUILDING ANYWAY, AND ONLY IF NOT DOES THE CODER BUILD IT.

⚠ THAT IS BETTER THAN A SEQUENCE BECAUSE IT MAKES THE ORDER EMERGENT. THE LIST IS NOT A PLAN TO FOLLOW  IT IS WHAT THE RULE PRODUCES. When work stops because something does not exist, THE RULE DECIDES WHAT GETS BUILT NEXT.

THE HIERARCHY: CAN THE BUILDER MAKE IT, then CAN THE APP MAKE IT, then CAN ANYTHING ELSE ALREADY ON THE PATH MAKE IT, and ONLY THEN DOES THE CODER WRITE IT DIRECTLY.

⚠ AND THE REASON STEP 4 IS LAST IS THE SAME REASON THE WHOLE BUILD ORDER EXISTS: A CODER WRITING AN ARTIFACT BY HAND PRODUCES THE ARTIFACT AND TESTS NOTHING. A TOOL PRODUCING IT PRODUCES THE ARTIFACT AND TESTS THE TOOL  ON A REAL JOB, WHICH IS THE ONLY KIND OF TEST WORTH HAVING.

⚠⚠ AND IT RETROACTIVELY EXPLAINS THE BUILDERS POSITION, WHICH PT-1346 HAD RULED WITHOUT A GENERAL PRINCIPLE BEHIND IT. The app reaches New Game, needs a package, and none exists. THE RULE ASKS STEP 1: CAN THE BUILDER MAKE A PACKAGE? IT CAN  THAT IS WHAT A BUILDER IS. So the Builder gets built and the test bed is its output. HAND-WRITING THAT PACKAGE WOULD HAVE BEEN STEP 4 APPLIED AT STEP 1, which is precisely the error PT-1346 corrected. THE RULE GENERALISES THE CORRECTION RATHER THAN JUST RECORDING IT.

⚠ WHAT IT PREVENTS, BOTH WORTH STATING. HAND-AUTHORED CONTENT BECOMING PERMANENT: a file written by a coder to unblock something HAS NO TOOL THAT CAN REGENERATE IT, so IT IS A FIXTURE NOBODY CAN REPRODUCE  and ASSET-REPLACEMENT-01 already names that shape, THINGS WRITTEN AS TEMPORARY HAVE A WAY OF SHIPPING.

AND IT PREVENTS BUILDING TOOLS NOBODY HAS NEEDED YET, because ⚠ THE RULE FIRES ONLY WHEN WORK STOPS. Nothing gets built speculatively because it seems like the Builder ought to have it  which is the same discipline as BUILD-ORDER-01s no-building-ahead, arrived at from the other direction.

## PT-1349 — THE STOP PROTOCOL. ⚠ A CODING AGENT MAY NOT APPLY THE RESOLUTION RULE

Owner described the loop: when Claude Code hits a wall it should STOP, RECORD IT, AND SEND A PROMPT BACK  and then the question OK, WHAT DO WE NEED TO BUILD NOW, DO WE SWITCH TO BUILDER, DO WE SWITCH TO APP gets answered here.

⚠ AND THE REASON IT MUST WORK THAT WAY IS STRUCTURAL RATHER THAN PROCEDURAL. PT-1347s rule asks WHAT THE BUILDER, THE APP, OR SOMETHING ELSE ON THE PATH COULD MAKE. THAT REQUIRES THE WHOLE SYSTEM IN VIEW. AN AGENT WORKING ON ONE SCREEN DOES NOT HAVE IT  AND IF IT RESOLVES THE WALL ALONE IT WILL ALWAYS REACH STEP 4, BECAUSE WRITING THE THING IS WHAT IS IN FRONT OF IT.

So the agent NEVER DECIDES WHAT GETS BUILT NEXT. THE LOOP: STOP without working around it, RECORD what stopped the work, HAND BACK a prompt describing the wall, THE RULE IS APPLIED with the whole system in view and the owner decides, AND A NEW PROMPT GOES OUT WHICH MAY BE FOR A DIFFERENT PROGRAM ENTIRELY.

⚠ THAT LAST PART IS THE POINT: THE ANSWER TO A WALL IN THE APP MAY BE GO BUILD PART OF LOOM. That is a decision NO AGENT INSIDE THE APP CAN MAKE, and it is the decision the whole build order turns on.

A STOP REPORT MUST CARRY FOUR THINGS: what was being built and what stopped it; ⚠ WHAT IS MISSING STATED AS A NEED RATHER THAN AS A PROPOSED SOLUTION, because a proposed solution is step 4 smuggled in; ⚠ WHAT WAS NOT DONE ABOUT IT, since AN AGENT THAT HALF-SOLVED A WALL BEFORE REPORTING HAS ALREADY SPENT STEP 4; and whether anything was learned about a spec, since WALLS ARE WHERE SPECS MEET REALITY.

⚠ AND A STOP IS THE SYSTEM WORKING RATHER THAN FAILING. ROADMAP-02 already predicts STEP 4 IS WHERE THE FORMAT BREAKS and says steps 1 to 3 are confident while the rest is forecast  SO A WALL AT STEP 4 CONFIRMS THE FORECAST RATHER THAN DEFEATING IT.

AND ⚠ AN AGENT THAT NEVER STOPS IS MORE WORRYING THAN ONE THAT STOPS OFTEN: it means WALLS ARE BEING WORKED AROUND SILENTLY, and A WORKED-AROUND WALL IS HAND-AUTHORED CONTENT WITH NO TOOL THAT CAN REGENERATE IT  which is exactly what PT-1347s hierarchy exists to prevent.

ONE OF THE TWO GOT DESIGNED AND THE OTHER DID NOT, and it was the one nobody uses.

THREE FIELD CHANGES. ⚠ authors BECOMES REQUIRED, having been optional  EVERY STORE TILE IN EXISTENCE SHOWS AN AUTHOR, AND A TILE CANNOT RELY ON AN OPTIONAL FIELD. summary IS NEW AND REQUIRED, one line, because A TILE WITH ONLY A NAME CANNOT TELL YOU WHAT A PACKAGE IS. cover IS NEW AND OPTIONAL, a path to a still image.

⚠ AND THE ASYMMETRY IS THE POINT: summary IS REQUIRED AND cover IS NOT. A PACKAGE WITH NO SUMMARY IS UNBROWSABLE; A PACKAGE WITH NO COVER IS PLAIN. ONE BREAKS THE SCREEN, THE OTHER DOES NOT. And cover must stay optional because A PACKAGE MUST BE MAKEABLE WITHOUT ART.

⚠ NOTHING TEMPORAL, DELIBERATELY. No created, no modified, no last-played. AN AUTHOR WRITING A DATE INTO A MANIFEST IS WRITING A CLAIM, NOT A FACT.

There, the app guessing would have been ASSERTING A FACT THE FORMAT DOES NOT RECORD. Here THE APP MAY GUESS, BECAUSE WHICH TILE SORTS FIRST IS NOT A FACT ABOUT THE PACKAGE. Same mechanism, different question, different answer.

⚠ AND ONE CONSEQUENCE FOR THE BUILDER IS FLAGGED RATHER THAN LEFT TO BITE: summary BECOMES A THIRD THING NEW PACKAGE WOULD ASK, WHICH BREAKS PT-1356s TWO-NAME PATH. ## PT-1360 — TILESETS REOPENED AND ADMITTED. ⚠ PT-1344 ruled out 3D GEOMETRY and I dismissed a VISUAL THEME along with it

Owner reopened the question and was right to. PT-1344 said an area has no tileset. ⚠ THAT DISMISSED THE WRONG THING: AREA-FORMAT-01 CORRECTLY RULES OUT HEIGHTMAPS, TERRAIN MESHES AND WALKMESHES, WHICH PT-1319 SETTLED  BUT TILESET IN AURORA MEANT TWO THINGS AT ONCE AND ONLY ONE OF THEM WAS GEOMETRY.

⚠ ADMITTED: A TILESET IS A VISUAL THEME. SAME GRID, SAME SEMANTICS, DIFFERENT ART. Endar Spire gives metal decking and bulkheads; Taris Undercity gives rubble and rusted plate. A WALL IS STILL A WALL  ONLY THE PIXELS CHANGE.

IT COSTS THE ENGINE NOTHING BECAUSE IT CHANGES NO RULE. ⚠ AND WITHOUT IT EVERY AREA IN EVERY PACKAGE LOOKS IDENTICAL  FLAT SQUARES FOREVER, which is where AREA-FORMAT-01 6 was quietly heading.

⚠ AND IT IS THE FIRST CONCRETE CASE OF PT-1351s OPEN QUESTION. A tileset is exactly the thing that could be EXTRACTED FROM KOTORS OWN FLOOR AND WALL TEXTURES or AUTHORED FRESH AND SHIPPED. Whichever way the ours-versus-theirs line falls, TILESETS ARE WHERE IT LANDS FIRST  which makes that decision concrete rather than abstract for the first time.

⚠ ADMITTED: A TILESET CARRIES PREFAB PIECES. THIS IS CLOSEST TO WHAT AURORAS TILESETS ACTUALLY WERE  YOU PAINTED WITH PIECES, NOT WITH INDIVIDUAL TILES. A corridor section, a junction, a room.

AND ⚠ IT IS THE SAME ONE-VERB PAINT MODEL AT A LARGER GRAIN: TRACE-106 found NINE PALETTE BUTTONS ALL HINTED PAINT SOMETHING, and A PREFAB IS ANOTHER THING TO PAINT  IT ADDS NO VERB. STAMPING A ROOM BEATS PAINTING FORTY SQUARES, and that is the difference between an authoring tool and a spreadsheet.

⚠ DEFERRED: A TILESET DECLARING ITS OWN TILE VOCABULARY. 6 already asks whether a tile has a type beyond passable  cover, difficult terrain, hazard  and a tileset COULD declare its own, a ship having bulkhead and a swamp having water.

MORE POWERFUL AND MORE DANGEROUS. ⚠ IF PACKAGES DECLARE THEIR OWN TILE TYPES, THE ENGINE MUST HANDLE TYPES IT HAS NEVER SEEN  and ENGINE-INTERFACE-01s FAIL LOUDLY rule means IT WOULD HAVE TO REFUSE THEM, WHICH MAKES THE PACKAGE UNLOADABLE RATHER THAN MERELY PLAIN. NOT RULED OUT, NOT ADMITTED. The other two are ADDITIVE; this one CHANGES WHAT THE ENGINE MUST UNDERSTAND.

ROADMAP-02 UPDATED: 4a asks NAME, SIZE AND TILESET  the same three Aurora asked, minus its two finish checkboxes  and PREFABS ARRIVE AT 4c, since painting a room is a paint action.

## PT-1361 — ⚠⚠ A PACKAGE INVENTS NOTHING. TYPES ARE OURS AND FIXED; ART AND PREFABS ARE ANYONES AND UNLIMITED

Owner ruled the deferred question from PT-1360 and the answer is better than deferring it: A PACKAGE SHOULD NOT INVENT A NEW TYPE OF ANYTHING, RATHER THEY ARE PREDEFINED.

TILE TYPES ARE PREDEFINED BY US AND FIXED  ground, wall, water, and whatever else the rules need. THE ENGINE KNOWS EVERY ENTRY BECAUSE WE WROTE THE LIST, AND A TILESET PICKS FROM IT. A water tile is water everywhere: YOU CANNOT SIMPLY WALK OVER IT, AND THE ENGINE KNOWS THAT BECAUSE THE TYPE IS OURS. Owners framing: A PROPER GAME BOARD THAT FOLLOWS THE RULES.

⚠⚠ AND THAT SPLIT IS WHAT MAKES COMMUNITY TILESETS SAFE AND UNLIMITED AT THE SAME TIME, WHICH IS THE THING MOST SYSTEMS CANNOT MANAGE. A TILESET SOMEONE MADE IN THEIR BEDROOM CANNOT BREAK A PACKAGE, BECAUSE THERE IS NOTHING IN IT THE ENGINE HAS TO UNDERSTAND. IT SUPPLIES PIXELS AND PREFABS AGAINST A VOCABULARY THAT ALREADY EXISTS.

SO THE ANSWER TO WHAT IF SOMEONE DECLARES quicksand IS: THEY CANNOT, AND THEY NEVER NEEDED TO. THEY MAKE QUICKSAND-LOOKING ART ON A difficult TILE. Unlimited appearance, zero engine risk, EVERY PACKAGE LOADS.

⚠ AND IT IS THE REASON PT-1334s EXCHANGE CAN ACCEPT A STRANGERS WORK WITHOUT INSPECTING IT. That was listed as an unsolved problem  trust and moderation  and this removes a whole category of it: A TILESET CANNOT CARRY A RULE, SO IT CANNOT CARRY A BAD ONE.

⚠ AND THE OWNERS STATED AMBITION IS WHY THIS MATTERS RATHER THAN BEING TIDY: THE HOPE IS THAT PEOPLE GO OUT AND CREATE THEIR OWN TILES, DOWNLOAD EACH OTHERS, AND MAKE MAPS WITH THEM  A COMMUNITY OF MODDERS AS THE POINT RATHER THAN A SIDE EFFECT. An architecture where a stranger cannot break your game is the precondition for that.

CONCRETE FIRST SETS PROPOSED BY OWNER, and they are the PT-1351 asset question made real: TATOOINE TEXTURES FROM K1 AS GENERIC DESERT, DXUN AS JUNGLE, TARIS AS CITY.

⚠ AND ONE STUDY IS WORTH RUNNING: DAGGERFALLS PREFAB SYSTEM. Owner names it as the model, and TRACE-95 already established Daggerfall as the source we borrow structure from rather than KOTOR  its seeded gate, its per-conversation counter, its assembled-from-world-state topics. ITS RANDOM MAP BLOCKS ARE THE SAME IDEA AT THE LEVEL OF GEOGRAPHY, and nobody has looked at them.

## TRACE-107 — Daggerfalls blocks. ⚠⚠ ROTATION IS TWO BITS, THERE IS NO EDGE-MATCHING, and THREE GAMES DISAGREE ABOUT DOORS BY A FACTOR OF SEVEN

Shipped data only. ⚠ NO REIMPLEMENTATION SOURCE READ  Daggerfall Unity is not on the machine and nothing was borrowed from it. Both archives parse SELF-VALIDATINGLY: walking record sizes from the header lands EXACTLY on the first byte of the directory in both files with no slack, and A WRONG STRIDE WOULD NOT DO THAT.

BLOCKS.BSA: 1,295 records, 920 RMB exterior and 187 RDB dungeon, VARIABLE SIZE with a fourteen-fold range. ⚠ AND ABOUT TWENTY OF THE 1,295 ARE SOMEBODYS WORKING FILES, SHIPPED: FOO, FOOBAR, SHIT, BRUCE, TEST, TEMP, BACKUP, AAANEW, ZZZZZZZ.

⚠⚠ THE STRONGEST FINDING AND THE ANSWER TO THE QUESTION ASKED: ROTATION IS TWO BITS. Every RMB carries a 32-entry table, and across ALL 920 FILES  29,440 ENTRIES  the second UInt16 takes FOUR VALUES AND NO OTHERS: 0x0000, 0x4000, 0x8000, 0xC000. A QUARTER-TURN FIELD. A CORRIDOR SECTION IS AUTHORED ONCE AND USED FOUR WAYS.

⚠ AND ITS ARGUMENT FOR WHY THAT MATTERS MORE FOR US IS THE BEST LINE IN THE STUDY: GENERATION CAN AFFORD A BIG LIBRARY BECAUSE NOBODY BROWSES IT. AN AUTHOR BROWSES. A PALETTE OF 900 CORRIDOR PIECES IS UNUSABLE; 225 WITH A ROTATE KEY IS A PALETTE.

⚠⚠ AND THERE IS NO EDGE-MATCHING ANYWHERE. It looked and found none, with the positive evidence pointing the other way: variation is BY BULK  S, M and L of the same function, confirmed by triples like TVRNAS, TVRNAM, TVRNAL  and function codes describe WHAT A BLOCK IS RATHER THAN HOW IT CONNECTS.

THE LIKELY MECHANISM IS CONVENTION RATHER THAN DECLARATION  every block puts its street in the same place  ⚠ WHICH IS PRECISELY WHAT PACKAGE-FORMAT-01 4 CRITICISES NWN FOR. So this is A PLACE NOT TO COPY: CORRIDOR SECTIONS AND JUNCTIONS GENUINELY NEED EDGES THAT MATCH, CITY BLOCKS ONLY HAD TO SIT SIDE BY SIDE, AND DAGGERFALL HAS NO ANSWER TO LEND. A DECLARED EDGE VOCABULARY IS OURS TO INVENT.

CONTENTS AND SHAPE ARE SPLIT ACROSS TWO FILES: the block carries shape AND props, the location carries the instances. ⚠ THAT IS THE SAME SEAM WE DREW INDEPENDENTLY  AREA-FORMAT-01 3s template path versus per-instance tag, and PACKAGE-NAMING-01s path versus tag. DAGGERFALL PUT IT IN THE SAME PLACE. And the lesson for prefabs: A PREFAB MAY CARRY PROPS, BUT ANYTHING THAT DIFFERS BETWEEN TWO STAMPINGS MUST LIVE ON THE STAMPING.

⚠⚠ AND DOORS, WHERE THREE GAMES DISAGREE USEFULLY. DAGGERFALL PUTS DOORS ON THE LOCATION  a UInt32 count then that many EIGHT-BYTE RECORDS, confirmed by arithmetic that only works one way. AURORAS DESCENDANT MAKES A DOOR A FULL BLUEPRINT: 104 UTDs ship in K2 and one sample carries FIFTY-SIX FIELDS  nine lock fields, seven damage, seven trap, three saves, AND SIXTEEN SCRIPT HOOKS. OURS IS A connections ENTRY WITH NO LOCK AT ALL.

⚠ AND ITS READING OF THE SPREAD IS THE FINDING: EIGHT BYTES AGAINST FIFTY-SIX FIELDS IS NOT A DISAGREEMENT ABOUT DOORS, IT IS A DISAGREEMENT ABOUT WHAT A GAME IS. ## PT-1367 — PAINTING, ART AND PREFABS: ONE SYSTEM, THREE SIZES. ⚠ A PREFAB IS A SAVED SELECTION, AND IT PASTES RATHER THAN OVERLAYS

Owner designed the tile-authoring model. The verb stays Paint  confirmed three separate times by TRACE-16, TRACE-104 and TRACE-106  and WHAT CHANGES IS THE PAYLOAD AND THE SIZE.

PAINT WORKS ON A REGION: drag a box and the rectangle fills. A 3x4 OF FLOOR IS ONE GESTURE rather than forty clicks.

TEXTURES ARE 1x1 WITH VARIANTS. ⚠ AND OWNER CAUGHT THE REPETITION PROBLEM BEFORE IT WAS RAISED  a big floor tiled from one image looks obviously tiled. SOLVED THE WAY TRACE-95 FOUND DAGGERFALL SOLVING IT: SEEDED, NOT RE-ROLLED. A tileset ships three or four floors and THE ENGINE PICKS ONE FROM A HASH OF THE TILES POSITION  SAME SQUARE, SAME VARIANT, FOREVER. Varied without shimmering, at a cost of four drawings instead of one.

⚠⚠ AND THE LOAD-BEARING RULE: MULTI-TILE ART IS PIXELS ONLY AND NEVER DECIDES WHAT A SQUARE IS. A cargo-bay image spanning twelve squares changes HOW THEY LOOK AND NOTHING ELSE.

IF ART DECLARED TILE TYPES, TWO TRUTHS WOULD EXIST ABOUT ONE SQUARE  what the map says and what the art claims  AND EVERY ONE OF WHICH-WINS, WHAT-HAPPENS-ON-DELETE AND WHAT-HAPPENS-WHEN-TWO-OVERLAP BECOMES A RULE TO WRITE AND A BUG TO FIND. THE MAP IS THE SINGLE ANSWER.

⚠ AND THE PLAYER-FACING VERSION IS THE ARGUMENT THAT SETTLED IT: WHAT YOU SEE IS WHAT THE BOARD IS. A SQUARE THAT LOOKS LIKE FLOOR IS FLOOR, SO NOBODY EVER ASKS WHY CANT I WALK THERE  the question that ruins a tabletop app, BECAUSE ITS ANSWER LIVES IN A FILE THEY CANNOT SEE.

⚠ ART SNAPS TO THE GRID, WHICH WAS OWNERS ADDITION AND IT FIXES THE COST OF PIXELS-ONLY. It cannot land half a square off or be sized to a fraction of a tile. THE OBJECTION  PAINT FIRST, THEN PLACE ART  MOSTLY DISSOLVES WHEN ART CAN ONLY LAND ON SQUARES THAT ALREADY EXIST. And the Builder can then TELL YOU WHEN IT DOES NOT FIT, because it knows both. Grid-locked art also ROTATES IN QUARTER-TURNS, per TRACE-107s finding that Daggerfalls rotation is TWO BITS, FOUR VALUES ACROSS ALL 920 BLOCKS.

⚠⚠ AND THE PIECE THAT MAKES IT ONE SYSTEM IS OWNERS: A PREFAB IS A SAVED SELECTION. Paint a room, drop art on it, select it, save it  IT IS NOW IN THE PALETTE AND ANYONE CAN DRAG IT INTO ANY MAP.

SO A PREFAB IS NOT A SEPARATE AUTHORED THING WITH ITS OWN FORMAT. IT IS WHAT AN AUTHOR ALREADY MADE, KEPT. That is the stated accessibility goal exactly: PREMADE ROOMS FOR PEOPLE WHO DO NOT WANT TO PAINT ONE, MADE BY PEOPLE WHO DID.

⚠ AND A PREFAB DOES CARRY TILE TYPES, WHICH DOES NOT BREAK THE PIXELS-ONLY RULE, BECAUSE A PREFAB PASTES RATHER THAN OVERLAYS. STAMPING WRITES TILES INTO THE MAP AND THEN THE PREFAB IS GONE  what remains is tiles and art, EXACTLY AS IF PAINTED BY HAND. NO LIVE LAYER, NO SECOND SOURCE OF TRUTH, NO DELETE SEMANTICS.

And PT-1361 still holds throughout: a prefab carries ART AND TILES FROM OUR FIXED VOCABULARY, NEVER A RULE  so a strangers room cannot break your game.

⚠ AND THE DEBT IS VISIBLE WHILE IT ACCRUES RATHER THAN DISCOVERED AT THE END. A note is A ROW THAT SAYS THIS IS OWED. THIRTY NOTES IS A NUMBER YOU CAN LOOK AT IN MONTH TWO; THIRTY MISSING REPLACEMENTS FOUND THE WEEK BEFORE RELEASE IS A CRISIS.

## PT-1666 — AUTOSAVE ON A DOOR IS PER-DOOR AND OPT-IN, NOT UNCONDITIONAL

Owner ruling, REVISES PT-1665. Autosave does NOT fire on every door crossing by default. A door carries an authorable checkbox  save on use  and only a door with it CHECKED triggers the write. Unchecked, a crossing behaves as it did before autosave existed.

⚠ THIS OVERTURNS THE UNCONDITIONAL PART OF PT-1665, NOT THE MECHANISM: the write itself, the status-line word, and append-not-assign all stand. What changes is that the crossing no longer triggers it alone  the door's own field gates it.

Reason, inferred and stated as such: a door mid-dungeon before a boss fight is a natural save point; a door between two rooms in a tutorial corridor is not, and firing on every one trains players to ignore the word on the status line the way a fire alarm that goes off daily gets ignored. Author judgement decides which doors matter enough to save on, the same way PT-1442 lets an author decide a doctrine's want_range rather than deriving it.

Default value for the checkbox: unset. An author opts a door INTO autosave rather than opting doors out of it, so existing shipped packages do not silently start autosaving everywhere the day this lands.

AND THE GATES TWO ARMS HAD TO BECOME EXCLUSIVE for the same reason: || would have let an unchecked door write through the second arm, shipping inert with every existing test still green, because the first arm covers the checked case either way. Four distinct cases now, each named:

    checked door       write, and say so
    unchecked door      nothing
    fallback on load    write (PT-1605)
    ordinary resume      nothing (PT-1658)

RULED: CLOSED. Autosave thread is done  PT-1663, 1665, 1666, 1669. Both features shipped this session. Standing by for next direction.

## PT-1670 -- STUDY 31: COMBAT START IS PERCEPTION-DRIVEN AT RANGE, AND THERE IS NO COMBAT ROSTER. VISIBILITY-AS-MEMBERSHIP IS ALREADY OUR SHAPE

K1 only. Combat start: k_def_percept01 -> case 1002, gated on GetLastPerceptionSeen (SIGHT; hearing does not start a fight on this path), reaction delay = distance/10.0 seconds -- 2.0s at the default 20m perception range, 0.5s at 5m -- and the creature turns to face at HALF the delay, so it visibly notices before acting. SpeakString(SILENT_TALK) is an AI broadcast: one creature noticing propagates to allies, which is how a room engages with no group object existing.

AND NO COMBAT ROSTER EXISTS. GetIsInCombat is a PER-CREATURE boolean; nothing returns the combatant set. Combat is emergent, not a session. Encounter* is a false friend -- a KOTOR "encounter" is a spawner, not a fight.

AND VISIBILITY IS MEMBERSHIP: k_inc_generic disengages when the nearest SEEN enemy is invalid, re-derived per creature per evaluation. AND THERE IS NO ENEMY PANEL AT ALL -- mipc8x6 has three party slots and ONE singular target slot (LBL_NAME + PB_HEALTH, no index). The sidebar question has no answer because there is no sidebar; enemy awareness is world-space (reticle, arrow), not a panel.

Leaving combat: AI disengages when no seen enemy remains, OR a dialogue/cutscene/trigger script cancels it outright -- "combat ends because a conversation starts."

RULED FROM THIS: NO ROSTER IS CORRECT, DO NOT BUILD ONE. A fight needs no participant list -- PLAY-STATE-01 is already a projection, so "who is in this fight" is a QUERY, not a stored set. A locked roster is MORE machinery than the anchor has. And "every visible enemy" for the HUD, which the owner specified independently, IS OUR DESIGN and not inherited -- KOTOR never had a multi-enemy panel to inherit from. The nearest precedent is BG3's CombatantsOverlay with a count at each end for overflow, which is STATE's own "lead with the count" arrived at independently a second time.

AND THE GAP NAMED IS REAL: nothing in our engine detects at range -- KOTOR engages at 20m, ours at 0m. Not a simplification of KOTOR, the OPPOSITE behaviour. Queued rather than built: a distant enemy joining on a later round, reading STUDY 27's PerceptionRange work, is the shape to port.

NOT CHECKED, NAMED: K2 entirely (PT-1544's own warning that "K1 is the only fact" has been wrong before, on this exact kind of axis). ON_ATTACKED (1005), the other combat-start path. GN_RunDefaultAIRoutine, so in-fight target selection is unexamined.
